prior_year_events.impact_description: Take-on balances from the RITC increased gross claims outstanding (added gross reserves of GBP 234.962m).
Take-on balances from the QBE LPT increased gross claims outstanding by GBP 319.0m (50% of these provisions were subsequently ceded).
Subsequent ceding of 50% of the QBE LPT take-on provisions to Cavello Bay (reducing net impact by GBP 159.5m).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 388.0m in 2023. The movement is primarily driven by reserve take-ons associated with reinsurance transactions during the year (notably an RITC from Syndicate 1301 of GBP 234.96m and an LPT with QBE of GBP 319.0m, with 50% of the latter ceded to Cavello Bay). These reinsurance/treaty transactions materially increased gross claims outstanding and are the main contributors to the prior year deterioration.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year strengthening (gross GBP 388.016m) is taken from the Technical Provisions note (gross column) and explicitly includes large reserve take-ons from an RITC and an LPT; these reinsurance transactions materially distort comparisons and the claims development triangle. LOB-level allocation of the prior-year movement is not provided in the notes, so a single 'Treaty' attribution is used with moderate confidence. The claims development triangle contains large RITC additions (not genuine organic development), so it is unreliable for computing PYD here without adjustment.
